extra.question: For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012.
extra.evidence: August of 2012 refers to the Date value = '201208' ; Price per unit of product = Price / Amount;
extra.question_with_evidence: For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012. Hint: August of 2012 refers to the Date value = '201208' ; Price per unit of product = Price / Amount;
extra.SQL: SELECT T2.Consumption FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Price / T1.Amount > 29.00 AND T1.ProductID = 5 AND T2.Date = '201208'
